title_as_printed: Measured H2O activity from brucite-periclase reversals and KCl activity from sylvite saturation temperatures

footnotes_as_printed.a: Asterisk signifies sylvite saturation point. Gamma_H2O/KCl signifies the ratio of activity to mole fraction of H2O and KCl (conventional activity coefficient). xbar_H2O is the mean H2O mole fraction of a brucite-periclase bracket. f_H2O is the fugacity of H2O at a bracket T and P (Burnham et al. 1969, with logarithmic extrapolation to 15 kbar).

pressure_note: P of the experiment (piston-cylinder, kbar); no gas; activity of H2O in KCl-H2O fluid at P and T

value.what: H2O activity (fluid standard state: pure H2O at same P,T) derived by authors from brucite-periclase reversal brackets with thermodynamic data; blank on sylvite-saturation rows

value2.what: KCl activity from sylvite saturation temperature (blank on non-saturation rows); standard state as in paper

composition.other_species: KCl-H2O binary fluid; KCl mole fraction = 1 - xbar_H2O; brucite/periclase/sylvite solids present

extra_unmapped: rho_H2O g/cm3 (pure-water density at P,T, from literature)
conversion_needs: xbar_H2O is the bracket mean fluid composition
notes: Rows with asterisk are sylvite-saturation points (fluid KCl-saturated); a_H2O blank there and a_KCl given. Activities are derived from reversal brackets by thermodynamic analysis, not directly measured; included because the table is titled 'Measured' and gives water activity of KCl brines at high P,T.
